description:
Learn Kubernetes and prepare to pass the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) examination. This course is designed to provide a deep, practical understanding of Kubernetes administration, from foundational concepts to advanced troubleshooting. 

🏗️ The Linux Foundation provided a grant to make this course possible.

Use code FREECODECAMP to get 30% off training, certifications, and bundles from Linux Foundation.

https://training.linuxfoundation.org/

💻 All commands and code from the course (link will work soon): https://www.freecodecamp.org/news/prepare-for-the-kubernetes-administrator-certification-and-pass

⌨️ 0:00:00 Introduction

- Understanding the Kubernetes Architecture
